listing.name: Forza Horizon (Xbox 360) (Pinyon Shift)
listing.summary: A playable Forza Horizon preview according to the project, with rendering defects and slowdowns. Its launcher packages for Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64/Steam Deck and Apple Silicon macOS ARM64 build the game locally from your own disc or verified extracted files. Android is a separate alpha with an unconfirmed ABI. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
